core_features: Primary goal is to evoke fear, dread, or unease
Characters are threatened physically, psychologically, or spiritually
The unknown or the uncontrollable plays a key role
typical_settings: Isolated houses, hospitals, forests, small towns
Any place that can become claustrophobic or unsettling
typical_conflicts: Survival against a monster, entity, or curse
Trying and often failing to maintain sanity and safety
protagonist_archetypes: Researchers, investigators, or skeptics confronting the uncanny
tone_guidelines: Oppressive, tense, unsettling; moments of false safety are allowed but fragile.

required_elements: At least one truly frightening or disturbing event
A threat that cannot be easily neutralized or fully understood
Some lasting damage: not everyone walks away unscarred
forbidden_elements: Completely trivializing or explaining away the horror so it becomes a simple puzzle or joke
